about: Finals Game 4, June 10 2026: Spurs led 81-52 (27 at the half, 29 early in the third) and lost 107-106 to the Knicks on an Anunoby tip-in; biggest Finals comeback. Ends on the payoff.
name: Why did the Spurs lose a 29-point lead
pinned: The Spurs led by 29, went 3-for-17 from deep in the second half and lost on a tip-in with 1.2 seconds left. Is this the worst collapse in Finals history, or the greatest comeback?
slotLabel: DO NOT POST: Critic v2 (Oct 13) says abandon. A 7.1M-view Short already told this story; it hops across six stats; 'led the NBA Finals by 29' is wrong (it was Game 4)
